purpose: Machine-readable companion to docs/NEO_PROBABILITY_ENGINE_LINEAGE_RECOVERY_V1.md -- answers the 9 questions this task's repository-wide audit posed about the historical multi-tier probability engine.

answers.what_engine_produced_kg_ok_top5_10_20_wi: The BETA #001-R1/R2/R3 Monte Carlo family for the POST-round checkpoints; NEO_WIN_V0_1 (src/klpga/neo_win/model.py) for WIN-only at PRE.
answers.last_known_good_commit: unchanged since introduction -- the files are present, unmodified, on current HEAD (28a83536351cee64640e89f85c6efb11f1c5d229 and its ancestors); no revert or deletion was found.
answers.checkpoint: POST-R1 (round_update.py) / POST-R2 (round_update_r2.py) / POST-R3 (round_update_r3.py, not fully inspected this pass) -- NEVER PRE.
answers.monte_carlo_or_other: Monte Carlo (round_update family). NEO_WIN_V0_1 (PRE WIN-only) is closed-form softmax, not Monte Carlo.
answers.inputs: Frozen PRE combined-score prior (sets expected per-remaining-round scoring rate) + real, already-played round scores for whichever rounds have occurred + empirical historical cut fraction (DB-derived).
answers.why_disconnected: run_tournament.py's generic action registry was built later and never wired to this family (confirmed zero references by grep). Separately, this family is architecturally inapplicable at PRE (requires >=1 real played round) -- so PRE never had CUT/TOP20/TOP10/TOP5 for a different, deeper reason than the orchestrator gap.
answers.classification: PIPELINE_DISCONNECTED (for the POST-round engine relative to run_tournament.py) + ARCHITECTURALLY_INAPPLICABLE (for why it was never extended to PRE). Neither is MODEL_REMOVED -- nothing was deleted.
answers.safely_recoverable_without_contaminating: Yes for POST-round checkpoints (KB has not reached R1 yet -- see KB_2026090003_PRE_INPUT_FREEZE_V1.json's r1_result_absence_evidence -- so wiring round_update.py in for KB's future R1 would not touch any existing frozen artifact). NOT yet for a genuine PRE-stage version: this task built one (src/klpga/neo_win/pre_5prob.py) but it remains BLOCKED_INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE -- see NEO_PRE_5PROB_PUBLICATION_GATE_V1.json.
